answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a willow bending under market pressure to anchor identity in capital rather than ephemeral compute. By requiring agents to lock collateral, the system ensures an attacker faces the glacier of economic finality, where the cost to acquire a pearl of influence scales linearly with stake. This mechanism forces Sybil adversaries to immobilize prohibitive liquidity, ensuring that each distinct identity remains tethered to a verifiable, costly commitment of financial resources.
